name: B10-0424/2026 – After § 6 – Am 2
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 6a. Reaffirms freedom of conscience and expression, including the right to criticise, satirise, caricature or reject religions and religious doctrines, including Islam, and the right to leave any religion; calls on the Member States to protect people exercising these freedoms against violence, threats and intimidation and rejects restrictions equivalent to blasphemy prohibitions;
